personality_one_liner: Cinematic, nocturnal dating platform with frosted glass cards, restrained obsidian depth, and high-value intentional connection.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room, comfortable touch targets, fixed bottom action safe-area alignment.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on hero cards and profile stacks
Apply translucent blur to sticky bottom navigation and headers
Pair blur with ≥75% dark surface tint for crisp text legibility
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or dense text blocks
Avoid stacking more than two glass surfaces in a single viewport

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the codebase is strictly segregated into three folders: mobile (Expo React Native), backend (Python FastAPI), and admin_web (React Admin Web Panel + Landing Page). Never hard-code dating niches; rely on the backend configuration engine for app name, modes, options, and profile schema. Maintain WCAG AAA contrast compliance against the obsidian glass surfaces, enforce 44x44pt minimum touch targets, and apply the 3-stop gradient scrim on all image overlays.
